how: node .5ds/taste/sources.mjs fetches these pages, reads the date at each page's 'near' words (the newest date in the page when there are none), and writes 1 line per platform to .5ds/taste/notes.md. A page newer than the platform's checked date wins over the guide: read the element named in 'read' and note the new rule.

facts.fact: shadcn 4.23.0 is the version the guide pins
npx shadcn@4.23.0 init -t next -d -y -n web makes a Next.js app in web, with web/app/globals.css, web/app/layout.tsx and web/.git, and asks nothing
facts.how: init --help read, and a real run on 2026-11-17 checked by framework/tests/test_design_look.mjs

facts.fact: iOS 27, iPadOS 27 and macOS 27 were released on 14 September 2026
iOS 27.2 lets people set Liquid Glass from ultra clear to fully tinted
Macs with touch displays: touch is for brief, intentional interactions
Google Play requires new apps and updates to target API 36
Expo SDK 58 is built for iOS 27 and includes React Native 0.88
Apps built with the iOS 27 SDK get resizable scenes; requireFullScreen no longer opts out
Expo UI carried no alpha or beta badge in the Expo docs, while Expo Router's Experimental Stack and Split View were marked alpha
Flutter 3.50.0 is stable; Material and Cupertino moved to the material_ui and cupertino_ui packages
Playwright 1.65.1, pinned by shots.mjs, has the screenshot command with --viewport-size and --color-scheme
